title.en: auto, after one step by contradiction

t.zh: 规则书里多了<part-ref to="part:raa"></part-ref>，写成规则是 ⟦¬¬?A⟧ ⟹ ?A。auto 只用引入和消去规则；这条规则的结论对得上任何目标，放进搜索，就会把每个目标换成「并非并非」，再换一次，没有尽头。
t.en: The rule book now holds <part-ref to="part:raa"></part-ref>, as a rule ⟦¬¬?A⟧ ⟹ ?A. auto uses only introduction and elimination rules; this rule’s conclusion fits any goal, and in the search it would turn every goal into a “not not”, and again, without end.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手：完成需要证明的测试目标，对指定的失败目标报告失败。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves the required test goals and reports failure for the designated failure cases.

hint.zh: 在 auto 之前，自己先用几条规则。
hint.en: Before auto, apply a few rules yourself.
